facets.name: overview
facets.label: Overview
facets.describes: What this area of the business is for, in a paragraph somebody outside it can follow, and which things belong to it and not to anywhere else.

facets.name: aggregates
facets.label: Aggregates
facets.describes: Which thing here owns the others, so that a change to any of them goes through it. The same words as the terms below, saying something else about them: this settles nothing about what a word means.

facets.name: terms
facets.label: Terms
facets.describes: The words this area uses, and what each one means here. One row per word.

facets.name: rules
facets.label: Rules
facets.describes: What must hold here. One heading per rule, which says what holds and why it does, with somewhere it came from so it can be checked against its source.

facets.name: invariants
facets.label: Invariants
facets.describes: What must never happen. The same Fact Kind as a Rule and held to a higher bar, because an invariant nobody has corroborated twice is not yet enough to build on.

facets.name: crew
facets.label: Crew
facets.describes: Who does the work here. The same words as the terms above and saying something else about them: this settles who somebody is, not what a word means.

facets.name: orders
facets.label: Orders
facets.describes: What can be asked of this area, and who is allowed to ask for it. One row per request, naming somebody the crew above settles.
